physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-09.material: A cikin halayen nuclear fusion $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, yawan kowane barbashi shi ne $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Ana ɗaukar kuzarin da ya yi daidai da $1\,\mathrm{u}$ a matsayin $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, kuma ana watsi da kuzarin motsin barbashin kafin halayen. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, kuzarin $E$ da ake fitarwa a wannan halayen, da kuzarin motsin da neutron ke da shi idan aka ƙiyasta cewa girman motsin $\mathrm{^4He}$ da neutron da aka samar daidai yake kuma rabon yawansu $4:1$ ne?
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: Dokokin motsi na Newton da ra'ayin musamman na dangantaka
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: A cikin halayen nuclear fusion $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, yawan kowane barbashi shi ne $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Ana ɗaukar kuzarin da ya yi daidai da $1\,\mathrm{u}$ a matsayin $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, kuma ana watsi da kuzarin motsin barbashin kafin halayen. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, kuzarin $E$ da ake fitarwa a wannan halayen, da kuzarin motsin da neutron ke da shi idan aka ƙiyasta cewa girman motsin $\mathrm{^4He}$ da neutron da aka samar daidai yake kuma rabon yawansu $4:1$ ne?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$ don haka $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Bayan halayen girman motsin barbashi biyun daidai yake, don haka $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ kuma $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Saboda haka $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Idan aka juya daidaitawar yawa a juye sai $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (amsa mara kyau ②); idan aka raba kuzarin gida biyu sai amsa mara kyau ③; idan aka yi kuskuren lissafin $\Delta m$ a matsayin $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$ sai amsa mara kyau ④.

physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
